selected_architecture: transactional candidate materialization followed by deterministic acceptance-bundle compilation
flow: validate one Plan source and run WPRA twice
materialize every declared SWU candidate in an isolated transaction without canonical writes
validate candidate outputs with declared post-produce commands
freeze one exact candidate bundle and material receipt
compile canonical preacceptance manifest and normalized execution projection from Plan plus candidate bundle
run all 11 real consumer boundaries twice with no effects
join independent review and enforced adoption evidence
emit and validate exactly one owner request

terminalize and join owner closeout and continuity
